result.title: PointX: Multi-View Consistent Intrinsics by Querying Surface Points
result.summary: The appearance of a scene is determined by the albedo, roughness, metallicity and normal of every point on its surface, and by the light that reaches it, its irradiance. Recovering these intrinsics from images is ambiguous, and methods that predict them per pixel give the same surface point a different decomposition in every view. We introduce PointX, a simple feed-forward model that predicts intrinsics per 3D surface point instead. A multi-view transformer encodes a set of unposed images, and for any queried surface point, PointX pools the point's tokens across the views in which it appears and decodes the point's intrinsics once. Each point of a 3D reconstruction of the scene, such as a point cloud or a mesh, thus receives a single prediction, which is exactly consistent across views by construction and enables view-consistent relighting and editing. The same model also predicts per-view maps, from one image or many, by querying the point seen at every pixel. These maps agree across views up to the precision of the estimated geometry and correspondences. PointX is significantly more consistent than existing methods, while remaining competitive in accuracy from a single image and improving as views are added. Project page: https://pointx-paper.github.io/

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PointX：用多视图 transformer 编码一组未标定姿态的图像，对任意查询的 3D 表面点汇聚其在各视图中的 token，一次性解码该点的 albedo、粗糙度、金属度与法向，从而由构造保证跨视图一致的本征分解，并支持一致的重光照与编辑。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按 3D 查询点跨视图收集并汇聚 token、只解码一次」的机制，可能与 LVR 中按查询筛选视觉证据、把多视图信息压成一致内部状态的问题相关，可供核查；但该文属逆渲染，不涉及推理生成与停止决策。
